core_insights.insight: Repeated legacy evidence remains an occurrence-level fact.
core_insights.why_it_matters: A compatibility reader must preserve repeated evidence instead of silently deduplicating it.
core_insights.generalization: Immutable source records should retain every evidence occurrence in its original order.

core_insights.insight: Untimed evidence remains explicitly unavailable for timestamp recovery.
core_insights.why_it_matters: V1 inline evidence does not contain structured timing metadata.
core_insights.generalization: Missing evidence provenance should remain visible rather than being fabricated.
evidence_quotes: A plain V1 evidence string has no timestamp.

deep_dives.research_question: When should a legacy evidence string be considered recoverable?
deep_dives.why: Only unique exact matches can safely establish a timestamp.

project_ideas.name: Unicode-safe corpus reader
project_ideas.hypothesis: A canonical UTF-8 path keeps multilingual evidence intact across normalization and rendering.
project_ideas.poc: Build a tiny corpus containing CJK text, a combining mark, and an emoji.
project_ideas.measurement: Compare normalized and rendered text with the source samples.

architectural_implications.observation: Compatibility boundaries should preserve source distinctions.
architectural_implications.before: A reader might collapse repeated strings into one evidence item.
architectural_implications.after: The normalized contract carries every occurrence and its unavailable provenance.
architectural_implications.consequence: Later migrations can add recovery without rewriting the V1 baseline.

tradeoffs_and_failure_modes.benefit: Conservative handling avoids inventing an evidence timestamp.
tradeoffs_and_failure_modes.cost_or_risk: Some useful timing information remains unavailable until a safe match exists.
tradeoffs_and_failure_modes.evidence_quote: Untimed legacy evidence must not be presented as timestamped.

open_questions.question: Which later migration rule can safely recover a unique exact evidence match?
open_questions.why_unresolved: The V1 artifact stores inline strings without persistent evidence identifiers.
open_questions.research_direction: Compare exact summary quote matches while preserving ambiguity as unavailable.

key_claims.claim: A V1 baseline must preserve unavailable verification context.
key_claims.evidence: The fixture intentionally leaves the verification question unavailable.

connections.relationship: Unicode-safe serialization connects multilingual evidence to deterministic exploration.
